1.w: Does not wisdom cry out, and understanding give forth her voice?

2.w: At the head of the heights, beside the road, at the house of the paths, she takes her stand.

3.w: At the hand of the gates, at the mouth of the city, at the entrance of the doors, she cries out:

4.w: “To you⁺, O men, do I call, and my voice [is] to the sons of man!

5.w: Discern prudence, O simple ones; and [you] foolish ones, understand the heart.

6.w: Listen, for noble [things] do I speak, and the opening of my lips [is] uprightness.

7.w: For my mouth utters truth, and wickedness [is] an abomination to my lips.

8.w: In righteousness [are] all the words of my mouth; nothing in them [is] crooked or perverse.

9.w: All of them [are] plain to the intelligent, and upright to those finding knowledge.

10.w: Receive my instruction and not silver, and knowledge [above] choicest gold.

11.w: For better [is] wisdom than rubies, and all delights cannot be compared with her.

12.w: I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, and knowledge of discretion I find out.

13.w: The fear of YHWH [is] to hate evil; I hate pride, and arrogance, and the way of evil, and the mouth of perversity.

14.w: Counsel and sound wisdom [are] unto me; I am understanding; unto me [is] strength.

15.w: By me kings reign, and rulers decree justice.

16.w: By me princes rule, and nobles—all those judging [with] righteousness.

17.w: I love those who love me, and those seeking me earnestly will find me.

18.w: Riches and honor [are] with me, surpassing wealth and righteousness.

19.w: Better [is] my fruit than gold, even pure gold, and my produce than choice silver.

20.w: In the way of righteousness I walk, in the midst of the paths of justice,

21.w: to cause those loving me to inherit substance, and their treasuries I will fill.

22.w: YHWH acquired me at the beginning of His way, before His works at that time.

23.w: From everlasting I was poured out, from the head, from before the earth.

24.w: In [being] no depths, I was brought forth, in [being] no springs heavy with waters.

25.w: Before the mountains were sunk, before the hills, I was brought forth—

26.w: while He had not made the land, or the outside places, or the first dusts of the world.

27.w: In His establishing the heavens, I [was] there; in His inscribing a circle on the face of the deep,

28.w: in His strengthening the clouds above, in His making strong the fountains of the deep,

29.w: in His setting for the sea its limit, so that the waters would not cross over His command, in His marking out the foundations of the earth,

30.w: then I was beside Him [as] a craftsman, and I was a delight day by day, laughing before His face at every time,

31.w: laughing in the world of His earth, and delighting together with the sons of man.

32.w: So now, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

33.w: Listen [to] discipline and be wise, and do not neglect [it].

34.w: Blessed [is] the man listening to me, watching at my gates day by day, keeping watch [at] the posts of my doors.

35.w: For the one finding me has found life, and he brings forth favor from YHWH;

36.w: but the one sinning against me is wronging his soul; all those hating me love death.”
